tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page backdrop behind the reading panel and behind World art. Never carries body text directly.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The reading panel: posts, lore, lists. Default ground for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-quiet
tokens.usage: Inset areas inside the panel: OOC posts, quotes, dice results, segmented tracks, tonal neutral buttons.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the composer, dialogs, inputs. Sits one step above surface.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers (the frosted material fill).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface. Contrast on surface/quiet/raised/canvas: light 12:1, dark 12.2:1, high contrast 15.1 / 15:1.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, account handles, epithets, placeholders. Never fainter than this. light 5:1, dark 5.4:1, high contrast 7.7 / 7.6:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between posts, rows and panels. Not used where a boundary carries meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries (inputs, chips, outline buttons). light 3.3:1, dark 3.1:1, high contrast 5 / 4.7:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Filled primary action and the selected tab indicator. Boundary light 5.6:1, dark 7.9:1, high contrast 6.9 / 7.9:1 against surfaces.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill. light 5.7:1, dark 9:1, high contrast 7 / 9:1.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: links, text and outline buttons. light 4.9:1, dark 7.9:1, high contrast 7.3 / 7.9:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal button fill, selected chip, "Your turn" flag, text selection.

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft. light 7.3:1, dark 8.4:1, high contrast 7.3 / 8.4:1.

tokens.name: ornament
tokens.usage: World decoration: divider motifs, corner pieces, drop caps, dice icon. Motet itself shows it only on dice. light 4.2:1, dark 4.6:1, high contrast 4.6 / 4.6:1.

tokens.name: ornament-soft
tokens.usage: Large decorative fills behind ornament (rare).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px gap. Platform-owned: generated per World and held at light 6.7:1, dark 7.6:1, high contrast 6.7 / 7.6:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: filled fill. Platform-reserved hue; a World accent near it pushes it away. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on the danger fill. light 5.8:1, dark 7.1:1, high contrast 7.2 / 7.1:1.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors, as text and icons on surfaces. light 4.9:1, dark 6.3:1, high contrast 7.3 / 7.3:1.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger-ink (flags, chips, banners).

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warnings that do not block: filled fill. Platform-reserved hue; a World accent near it pushes it away. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Label on the caution fill. light 5.4:1, dark 7.6:1, high contrast 7.1 / 7.6:1.

tokens.name: caution-ink
tokens.usage: Warnings that do not block, as text and icons on surfaces. light 4.8:1, dark 6.6:1, high contrast 7.3 / 7.2:1.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind caution-ink (flags, chips, banners).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Completed or accepted states (teal, off the red–green axis): filled fill. Platform-reserved hue; a World accent near it pushes it away. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: on-positive
tokens.usage: Label on the positive fill. light 5:1, dark 8.1:1, high contrast 7.1 / 8.1:1.

tokens.name: positive-ink
tokens.usage: Completed or accepted states (teal, off the red–green axis), as text and icons on surfaces. light 4.8:1, dark 7:1, high contrast 7.4 / 7.3:1.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind positive-ink (flags, chips, banners).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: filled fill. Platform-reserved hue; a World accent near it pushes it away. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Label on the info fill. light 5.3:1, dark 7.7:1, high contrast 7.1 / 7.7:1.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Neutral information, as text and icons on surfaces. light 4.8:1, dark 6.7:1, high contrast 7.3 / 7.3:1.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind info-ink (flags, chips, banners).

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection highlight; ink stays readable on it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Smoke under modal dialogs.

tokens.name: chrome-bg
tokens.usage: Corner-island fill, translucent (the "veil"). Opacity is the lowest that keeps chrome-ink at 4.6:1 over pure black or white art, and never below 0.84.

tokens.name: chrome-bg-solid
tokens.usage: Opaque chrome fill: reduced transparency, menus opened from chrome, and the ring around inbox counts.

tokens.name: chrome-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons in the chrome islands. Always Motet ink, never World ink.

tokens.name: chrome-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Muted chrome text: the search placeholder, the switcher chevron.

tokens.name: chrome-line
tokens.usage: Island outline and the separator between the home mark and the World switcher.

tokens.name: chrome-accent
tokens.usage: Count badges and selected items inside chrome menus (Motet accent, never the World accent).

tokens.name: chrome-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on chrome-accent.

tokens.name: chrome-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state layer in chrome; also the search field fill.

tokens.name: chrome-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected items and the turn flag inside chrome menus.

tokens.name: chrome-on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text on chrome-accent-soft.

styles.name: ui-display
styles.usage: Titles of Motet pages (Home, Inbox, Account). Never inside a World.

styles.name: ui-heading
styles.usage: Section headings in Motet surfaces and dialogs.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Row titles, card titles, menu headings.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Controls and interface text. Buttons use 14/20 at weight 600.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Field labels, segmented items, kind labels.

styles.name: ui-meta
styles.usage: Metadata, handles, times. The smallest text Motet sets, apart from 12px count badges.

styles.name: read-body
styles.sample: Zażółć gęślą jaźń — powiedziała Ilse, nie podnosząc wzroku.
styles.usage: Posts and lore at 1.6 line height, 68ch measure. Readers may switch it to IBM Plex Sans and scale it.

styles.name: read-small
styles.sample: The ferry would not cross before the thaw.
styles.usage: Quotes inside posts, composer text on phones.

styles.name: world-title
styles.usage: World title in the masthead. A World replaces the family; size is multiplied by its display adjust.

styles.name: character-name
styles.usage: Speaker name on posts. Worlds may set it in their display face.

styles.name: face-oxanium
styles.usage: Technical science fiction. Uppercase with tracking; never for body text.

styles.name: face-stencil
styles.usage: Post-apocalyptic and industrial headings. Display sizes only.

styles.name: face-cormorant
styles.usage: Literary fantasy. Its small x-height needs the 1.16 display adjust the engine applies.

styles.name: face-grenze
styles.usage: Gothic horror: a legible blackletter hybrid. Headings and names.

styles.name: face-archivo
styles.usage: Contemporary strategy: condensed (wdth 78) headings with tabular figures.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Dice expressions, record identifiers, keyboard hints. Also a World display face (Kepler Relay).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight clusters.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a control group; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related fields; card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel gutters on phones; between list rows content.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Portrait-to-text column gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; section gaps inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel gutters on desktop; post rhythm (standard density).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between post groups in comfortable density.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top offset under the chrome islands.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Dice faces, tiny marks. Motet uses squircle corners (corner-shape); browsers without corner-shape draw the same radius round.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, flags, inline quotes. Motet uses squircle corners (corner-shape); browsers without corner-shape draw the same radius round.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menu items, OOC posts, dice results, portraits. Motet uses squircle corners (corner-shape); browsers without corner-shape draw the same radius round.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, posts in card layout, the composer, menus. Motet uses squircle corners (corner-shape); browsers without corner-shape draw the same radius round.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The reading panel, dialogs. Motet uses squircle corners (corner-shape); browsers without corner-shape draw the same radius round.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, inputs, segmented items. Presses morph it to 55% for spatial feedback. Motet uses squircle corners (corner-shape); browsers without corner-shape draw the same radius round.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Account avatars, switches, counts.

shadow.note: Key plus ambient pairs after Fluent 2, darker in dark themes. Separation never depends on shadow alone: forced colours remove it.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards and posts in card layouts; filled buttons.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Character cards, world marks over art.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: The reading panel and the composer.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, tooltips.

tokens.name: edge-light
tokens.usage: Inset top highlight and bottom shade that give a surface its edge. Combine with an elevation.

tokens.name: chrome-shadow
tokens.usage: Corner islands: edge highlight plus a soft lift.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, icon buttons, inputs at standard density (36 compact, 44 comfortable; 44 minimum on coarse pointers).

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on coarse pointers; small controls extend an invisible hit area to it.

tokens.name: chrome-offset
tokens.usage: Top space reserved under the corner islands; also scroll-padding-top.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length of prose.

tokens.name: portrait-col
tokens.usage: Width of the character portrait column beside a post.

duration.note: Springs from Material 3 Expressive, expressed as settle times. A World’s motion character rescales spatial and decor timings within caps.

tokens.name: dur-spatial-fast
tokens.usage: Settle time of the fast spatial spring (position, size, corner morph). Capped at 420ms. 0 under reduced motion.

tokens.name: dur-spatial-default
tokens.usage: Settle time of the default spatial spring (position, size, corner morph). Capped at 420ms. 0 under reduced motion.

tokens.name: dur-spatial-slow
tokens.usage: Settle time of the slow spatial spring (position, size, corner morph). Capped at 420ms. 0 under reduced motion.

tokens.name: dur-effects-fast
tokens.usage: Settle time of the fast effects spring (colour, opacity). Never overshoots.

tokens.name: dur-effects-default
tokens.usage: Settle time of the default effects spring (colour, opacity). Never overshoots.

tokens.name: dur-effects-slow
tokens.usage: Settle time of the slow effects spring (colour, opacity). Never overshoots.

tokens.name: dur-decor
tokens.usage: Decorative entrances (ornaments, header art). A World’s motion character scales it; 0 under reduced motion.

easing.note: Springs sampled to CSS linear(). Spatial springs may overshoot slightly; effects springs never do.

tokens.name: ease-spatial-fast
tokens.usage: Material 3 standard spatial spring (fast) sampled to linear(); pair with dur-spatial-fast.

tokens.name: ease-spatial-default
tokens.usage: Material 3 standard spatial spring (default) sampled to linear(); pair with dur-spatial-default.

tokens.name: ease-spatial-slow
tokens.usage: Material 3 standard spatial spring (slow) sampled to linear(); pair with dur-spatial-slow.

tokens.name: ease-effects-fast
tokens.usage: Critically damped effects spring (fast); pair with dur-effects-fast.

tokens.name: ease-effects-default
tokens.usage: Critically damped effects spring (default); pair with dur-effects-default.

tokens.name: ease-effects-slow
tokens.usage: Critically damped effects spring (slow); pair with dur-effects-slow.

tokens.name: ease-decor
tokens.usage: Decorative entrance curve.
